 The California Golden Bears take on the Virginia Cavaliers in Charlottesville, Virginia. Kickoff is set for 3:30 p.m. EST on ACC Network.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Virginia is favored by 11.5 points (-105) on the spread with a moneyline of -490. Cal is an 11.5-point underdog (-115) with a moneyline of +375. The total is set at 46.5 points (-110o / -110u).
 Here's my California vs. Virginia prediction and college football pick for Saturday, November 14, 2026.
 California vs. Virginia Pick: Cal +10 or Better 
 My Virginia vs. California best bet is on the Golden Bears. Find the best line available on our live NCAAF odds page .
 California vs Virginia Odds, Spread, Total
 California vs Virginia point spread : Virginia -11.5 (-105), California +11.5 (-115)
 California vs Virginia over/under : 46.5 (-110o / -110u)
 California vs Virginia moneyline : California +375, Virginia -490
 This game triggered one of our Action PRO betting systems, powered by Evan Abrams :
 Bounce Back Fade is a college football system that takes advantage of public overreaction to teams coming off a poor performance.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In conference play, when an opponent has just lost by more than three points and enters with only a one-game home or away streak, bettors often expect a strong rebound effort.
 Oddsmakers know this tendency and may shade the line toward that team, creating hidden value on the other side.
 By focusing on spreads between three and sixteen points, the system captures games that are competitive enough for the line to matter but not so close that small swings decide the outcome.
 In these situations, fading the supposed bounce-back team has historically delivered consistent returns, as motivation alone doesn't erase the underlying weaknesses that caused the initial loss.
 Yeah, Virginia is in a prime bounce-back spot: the Cavs are looking to snap a three-game losing streak at home against a West Coast team, and they've had two weeks to prepare following last Saturday's bye.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But let's not forget that the Cavs have lost five of their past seven games, with one of those two wins coming against Delaware.
 The offense can't move the ball (105th nationally in EPA per Play), and the defense struggles mightily to stop the run (125th nationally in Rush Success Rate allowed).
 Cal is a dreadful team, but I still feel this line is way inflated because of all the situational circumstances, and I think the Bears can keep it within a score.
 Pick: Cal +10 or Better
